settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Personalise how your workspace looks and behaves.

project.bugLabelsDescription: Labels applied automatically when filing a bug from a Software project.
project.bugLabelsEmpty: No labels yet. Create labels first to configure bug filing.

troiki.heading: Troiki System
troiki.description: Enable the Troiki productivity system to organise projects into priority categories and lock task priority by category. When disabled, existing Troiki assignments stay linked but all related icons and menu items are hidden, and task priority is no longer locked.

theme.heading: Theme
theme.description: Choose between light, dark, or matching your system.

language.heading: Language
language.description: Pick the interface language. Your choice is saved on the server.

weekly.heading: Weekly unplanned exclusions
weekly.description: Tasks with these labels will not show the unplanned badge even if not scheduled for the week.

autoLabels.heading: Auto-labels
autoLabels.description: When a task title contains the mask, the selected labels are attached automatically.
autoLabels.noLabelsAvailable: No labels available. Create labels first.
autoLabels.toastEmptyFields: Mask must not be empty and at least one label must be selected

version.heading: App version
version.description: The currently running version of Turboist.

twofa.heading: Two-factor authentication
twofa.description: Add a one-time code from your authenticator app on each login.
twofa.unavailable: Two-factor authentication is not configured on this deploy. Ask the administrator to set TOTP_SECRET_KEY in the environment to enable it.
twofa.setupHint: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (or enter the secret manually), then enter the 6-digit code to confirm.
twofa.recoveryHint: Save these recovery codes in a safe place. Each can be used once to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator. They will not be shown again.

session.heading: Active sessions
session.description: Sign out from all devices and browsers, including this one.

sessions.heading: Sessions
sessions.description: Devices and browsers currently signed in to your account. End any of them individually or sign out everywhere at once.
sessions.confirmRevokeDescription: The device will be signed out immediately and must log in again.
sessions.logoutOthers: Sign out of all other sessions
sessions.confirmLogoutOthersTitle: Sign out of all other sessions?
sessions.confirmLogoutOthersDescription: Every device except this one will be signed out. You'll stay logged in here.
sessions.logoutOthersFailed: Failed to sign out other sessions
sessions.confirmLogoutAllDescription: Every device, including this one, will be signed out. You'll be redirected to the login page.

privacy.heading: Public view
privacy.description: Hide everything you've marked as private from the UI.
privacy.hint: Use Public view when sharing screenshots. Mark sensitive projects, tasks, or labels as private from their action menu, then enable this toggle — they vanish from the sidebar, all task views, and pinned items. Marking a project private also hides its tasks; marking a parent task private hides its subtasks. Turn this off to bring everything back; nothing is deleted.

banner.heading: Today banner
banner.description: Show a message pinned at the top of the Today page. Markdown links like [text](https://example.com) are supported.

api.heading: API tokens
api.description: Use tokens to integrate external tools (e.g. n8n). A token authenticates requests to /api/v1/* via the Authorization: Bearer header.
api.warningOnce: Copy this token now. It will not be shown again.
api.confirmDeleteDescription: Integrations using this token will stop working. This cannot be undone.

backup.heading: Backup & Restore
backup.description: Download a snapshot of your data or restore it from a previously saved file.
backup.includeSettingsHint: Adds your interface preferences and global app settings to the backup. API tokens and sessions are never included.
backup.restoreDescription: Replaces all current projects, tasks, sections and labels with the contents of the backup file. This action cannot be undone.
backup.confirmDescription: All your current data will be permanently replaced with the contents of "{name}". This cannot be undone. The Restore button will unlock in {seconds}s.

deadLetter.heading: Dead-letter queue
deadLetter.description: Outbound federation events that a peer permanently rejected (a 4xx other than rate-limit). These are not retried automatically.
deadLetter.empty: No failed events. Everything has been delivered or is retrying.
deadLetter.loadFailed: Failed to load the dead-letter queue

audit.heading: Audit log
audit.description: Security-relevant federation events — handshakes, revokes, signature failures, replay attempts, and key changes — newest first, for investigating anomalies.
audit.empty: No federation activity has been recorded yet.
audit.loadFailed: Failed to load the audit log
audit.attackAlert: Possible attack on {peer}: {count} signature failures in a short window. Review this peer's activity below.

ops.heading: Operations
ops.description: Federation liveness, garbage-collection retention windows, and a full physical backup (including the federation tables and instance keypair).
ops.loadFailed: Failed to load federation operations data

retention.heading: Retention
retention.hint: How long tombstones, the outbox, and the inbox are kept before garbage collection. 0 means use the default. Changes apply on the next GC pass — no restart needed.
retention.outboxCapWarning: The outbox window is capped at {cap} days; a larger value is clamped.

backup.heading: Federation-aware backup
backup.hint: Download a complete physical copy of the database, including the federation tables and instance keypair. Restoring it under the same base URL keeps this instance's federation identity. This holds the database briefly — run it off-peak.

logs.heading: API Logs
logs.description: All backend API requests from this session. Logs are stored in memory and cleared on page reload.
logs.disabled: Logging is off. Enable the toggle to start capturing API requests.

calendars.heading: Google Calendar integration
calendars.description: Show selected Google Calendar events in Today, Tomorrow, and Week.
calendars.syncInfo: Events are fetched automatically when you open task lists, at most once every 2 minutes.
calendars.hidePastEventsDescription: Timed events whose end time has passed move out of the active list and into Completed today.
calendars.googleNotConfigured: Google Calendar OAuth is not configured on this server.
calendars.configDescription: Enter the credentials for connecting Google Calendar.
calendars.configHelpAria: How to create Google OAuth credentials
calendars.configHelpEnableApi: Enable Google Calendar API for the project.
calendars.configHelpCreateClient: Create OAuth client ID with the Web application type and add the callback URL below to Authorized redirect URIs.
calendars.configHelpCopyKeys: Copy Client ID and Client secret into these fields, then save.
calendars.configDeleteFailed: Failed to delete Google OAuth keys
calendars.confirmDeleteConfigDesc: The app will forget the saved Client ID and Client secret. Connected calendar accounts stay listed, but syncing will not work until you save OAuth keys again.
calendars.sourcesDescription: Choose which calendars appear in task views.
calendars.accountsDescription: Google accounts authorized for calendar access.

auth.setupSubtitle: Turboist runs single-user. Pick a username and password.
auth.otpAppHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.otpRecoveryHint: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you enabled 2FA.

quickAdd.autoLabelHint: Auto-detected from title — will be applied on save

view.moveAllTasksTitle: Move all tasks to another phase

troiki.rulesIntro: Three categories, max 3 projects each. Capacity in Medium and Rest is earned by completing tasks in the category above.

rules.mediumHint: +1 slot per completed task in Important.
rules.restHint: +1 slot per completed task in Medium.
rules.bullet1: Removing a project frees its slot but does not unlock the next category.
rules.bullet2: Earned capacity accumulates and never expires.
rules.bullet3: Re-completing a task does not yield extra capacity.
rules.bullet4: All tasks in an assigned project inherit the category priority.

section.importantDescription: Top three projects that demand focus.

troiki.cycleInProgress: Cycle in progress — Medium and Rest unlock as you complete the previous category.
troiki.initialFill: Initial fill — assign projects to Important, then optionally seed Medium and Rest. Press Start to lock in the cycle.
troiki.startDisabled: Assign at least one project to Important first
troiki.resetDescription: All projects will be unassigned from their categories, earned capacity will be reset to zero, and the cycle will stop. Task priorities are kept as-is. This cannot be undone.
troiki.lockedTitle: Locked — earn capacity by completing the previous category
troiki.openInitialTitle: Open during initial fill — capacity is locked in when you press Start
troiki.unlockMedium: Complete an Important task to unlock a Medium slot.
troiki.unlockRest: Complete a Medium task to unlock a Rest slot.
troiki.assignHint: Use the project actions menu (⋯ → Assign to Troiki) to assign projects to this section before starting the cycle.
troiki.noTasks: No tasks yet — add one to get started.

toast.pickProject: Pick a project in this Troiki section

federation.badgeTooltip: This project is shared with other instances
federation.readOnlyTooltip: You have read-only access to this federated project
federation.taskReadOnly: Read-only — this task belongs to a federated project shared with you
federation.ownerOfflineTooltip: The owner instance has been unreachable for a while. Your changes are saved locally and will sync when the owner comes back online.

peers.title: Peers
peers.revokeConfirmBody: This permanently revokes {name}'s access to this project. They will no longer receive updates, and their copy becomes read-only. This cannot be undone — re-collaboration requires a new invite.
peers.keyIncident: {name} signature failed — possible key rotation or compromise. Its updates are being rejected until you trust the new key.
peers.trustKeyConfirmBody: Only do this if you have confirmed out-of-band that {name} legitimately rotated its key. We will fetch the peer's current published key, trust it, and resume applying its updates. If the key change was an attack, trusting it would accept forged updates.
peers.trustKeyFailed: Could not trust the new key

leave.confirmBody: You will stop receiving updates from the owner, and your local copy becomes a plain local project you can edit freely. The owner will see that you left. You will need a new invite to rejoin.
leave.done: Left the federated project — it is now a local copy
leave.failed: Could not leave the federated project

invite.title: Create invite
invite.description: Generate a one-time link to invite another instance to this project.
invite.warningOnce: Copy this link now — the secret is shown only once and cannot be recovered later.

join.title: Join a federated project
join.previewFailed: Could not load the project preview. The invite may be expired, revoked, or already used.
join.invalidInvite: No invite found in this link. Ask the project owner to send you a fresh invite link.
join.signInPrompt: Sign in to your instance to accept this invitation.
join.crossInstanceTitle: This invite opens on your own instance
join.crossInstancePrompt: Enter the address of your turboist instance to open this invite there.

steps.handshake: Verifying invite with the owner instance…

join.snapshotFailed: Could not copy the project from the owner. Nothing was saved — try accepting again.
join.versionUnsupported: This project uses a federation protocol version your instance does not support. Ask the owner to update, or update your instance.

errors.inviteInvalid: This invite is invalid, expired, revoked, or already used. Ask the owner for a fresh invite link.
errors.keyMismatch: The owner already knows your instance with a different key. Ask the owner to remove the old peer before re-inviting you.
errors.untrusted: The owner's identity could not be verified. The handshake was rejected for your safety.
errors.inviteGone: This invite is no longer valid. Ask the owner for a fresh invite link.

remoteEdit.title: Updated remotely
remoteEdit.body: This task was changed by another instance while you were editing. Reload to see the latest, or keep your in-progress edits.

resync.title: Re-synced from the owner
resync.body: This project was offline too long and was re-copied from the owner. Your unsent changes from before {date} were preserved but may have been overridden.

sync.syncedTooltip: All changes delivered and every peer is up to date.
sync.pendingTooltip: {count} changes have not yet reached every peer.
sync.unreachableTooltip: Peer {peer} has not responded in over 24 hours.
sync.keyMismatchTooltip: Peer {peer} key mismatch — manual action needed. Its events are not being applied.

visibility.badgeTooltip: This task belongs to a federated project shared with: {peers}
visibility.newTaskHint: This task will be visible to peer instances: {peers}
